problem.title: Why Standard AI Models Fail at Senior Code
problem.subtitle: Without structured engineering rules, even state-of-the-art LLMs default to generic tutorials, skip crucial security invariants, and bloat your prompt context.
problem.without.title: Vanilla LLM / Unprompted
problem.without.p1: Hallucinates bloated abstractions (flatpickr for datepickers, 200-line wrappers for fetch)
problem.without.p2: Skips timing-safe crypto checks and leaks internal stack traces on errors
problem.without.p3: Produces accessibility anti-patterns (no focus trap, missing ARIA contracts)
problem.without.p4: Loads all guidelines at once, clogging up to 100k context tokens per turn
problem.with.title: ContextOS Assisted Agent
problem.with.result: Result: Senior rigor, 54% less code, zero bloat
problem.with.p1: Runs the Ponytail 7-rung ladder — reducing generated code by 54% without losing safety
problem.with.p2: Enforces timingSafeEqual, parameterized SQL, and zero-leak error handling
problem.with.p3: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant by default with verified ARIA dialogs and keyboard traps
problem.with.p4: Dynamic resolution: only the exact 2–4 skills needed for the current prompt are loaded

benchmarks.title: Real-World Quality & Security Scores
benchmarks.subtitle: Evaluated on gpt-5.6-sol & claude-3-7-sonnet across 5 rigorous scenarios: AST invariants (60%) + Principal Architect review (40%).
benchmarks.s1.name: Secure Auth & Rate Limiting
benchmarks.s1.note: timingSafeEqual comparisons, bounded Redis rate-limiting, error stack redaction

benchmarks.s2.note: Full ARIA dialog contracts, Tab/Shift-Tab focus wrap, createPortal mount, unmount restore

slash.title: Slash Commands.
slash.subtitle: ContextOS maps development phases directly to slash commands in your AI chat. Each command activates a specialist mindset before writing a single line.
slash.spec.desc: Turn vague ideas into structured requirements and acceptance criteria.
slash.plan.desc: Decompose the spec into atomic, testable tasks (< 2 hours each).
slash.build.desc: Implement code task-by-task with TDD and minimal blast radius.
slash.test.desc: Run unit, integration, and E2E behavioral tests covering all edge cases.
slash.simplify.desc: Run the Ponytail 7-rung ladder to strip over-engineering and dead abstractions.
slash.review.desc: 5-axis quality gate: correctness, architecture, security, performance, design.
slash.ship.desc: Verify clean CI, lint checks, docs, and rollback plan before merging.
resolve.title: Dynamic Skill Resolution
resolve.subtitle: The .agents/ctx.js file is the Context Engine — it resolves the exact 2–4 skills needed for any prompt on the fly, preventing context window bloat.
resolve.feature1.title: Zero Context Bloat
resolve.feature1.desc: Only the exact 2–4 skills required are loaded. No dumping thousands of lines of irrelevant rules.
resolve.feature2.title: File-Aware Resolution
resolve.feature2.desc: Pass active files and ctx.js auto-detects the domain, phase, and roles from your stack.
resolve.feature3.title: Universal Agent Export
resolve.feature3.desc: Compile optimized rule bundles for Cursor, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Aider, and Zed.
resolve.terminal.cmd: node .agents/ctx.js resolve "Build an accessible modal component with React"
